summary: M8 ringtone library wiring verified GREEN. /ringtone-select renders exactly the 5 onboarding ringtones with the new labels (Classic, Piano Musical, Tropical Marimba, Celestial Calm, Modern HD) and matching subtitles + testIDs; no 6th row, no console errors during taps, Continue routes to /notifications-permission. /alarm-edit Sound row opens 'Pick a ringtone' modal exposing the full 34-item library (scrollable, maxHeight 420). Spot-checked extended labels — Heavy Alarm, Salsa, Super Alarm, Universfield, Marching Band, Bass Drop — all present in DOM. Tapping Salsa closed the sheet and updated the Sound row to 'Salsa'. All 34 MP3 assets present in /app/frontend/assets/audio/ringtones. No regressions: /reward?from=barcode renders streak + Mo-Su chips, /(main) shows 3 tabs, /alarm-edit renders without VirtualizedList red-box, /nickname accepts text, /challenges/barcode + /challenges/photo render camera chrome. The two pageerrors observed ('play() failed because the user didn't interact with the document first') are the browser autoplay-gate warning from the reward-page audio preview — pre-existing benign behavior, not introduced by M8.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/onboarding/ringtones.ts is clean: literal require() per asset, ONBOARDING_RINGTONES = RINGTONES.slice(0,5) keeps onboarding + alarm-edit catalogs in sync. findRingtone returns undefined for stale IDs (chime/gentle/pop/melody) as the request notes — acceptable degraded behavior.
/app/frontend/app/ringtone-select.tsx ref-based playerRef.current with pause()->remove() ordering looks correct; useEffect cleanup runs stopCurrent on unmount.
/app/frontend/app/alarm-edit.tsx wraps Sound list in inner ScrollView (maxHeight: 420) — adequate for 34 rows. No nested-VirtualizedList warning observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ringtone catalog now has 34 entries with new IDs (classic/piano/tropical/celestial/modern/heavy/alert/cinematic/danube/galaxy/bassdrop/hypertick/celebrate/sinepluck/loud/love/march/minion/mobile/mobiletone/neon/notif/phonealert/pianoring/pulse/redbubble/rhythm/ringring/aqua/salsa/superalarm/bright/turbo/universfield). Old IDs (chime/gentle/pop/melody) are intentionally gone. ONBOARDING_RINGTONES is the first 5 of RINGTONES. Sound picker on alarm-edit uses the full RINGTONES list inside a ScrollView with maxHeight 420.
